title.zh: 沙特阿美达兰总部遭袭起火，胡塞武装威胁打击利雅得石油设施，特朗普考虑拉土耳其参战
title.en: 沙特阿美达兰总部遭袭起火，胡塞武装威胁打击利雅得石油设施，特朗普考虑拉土耳其参战

current_state.zh: Saudi Aramco's Dhahran headquarters suffered a limited fire in an attack that Saudi-led coalition missile interceptions also hit residential areas, while Houthis threatened strikes on eastern province and Riyadh oil facilities, energy majors' executives left the Riyadh World Petroleum Congress, and Trump said he discussed the attacks with the Saudi crown prince and may bring Turkey into operations against the Houthis.
